<div class="card-body">
'''I've Lost Artoo!''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">Ｒ２をやられた！</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">１フォース消費して、宇宙船の操縦ドロイドかナビコンの破壊を試みる。運命数を引く。運命数＞１ならば、宇宙船に配備し、その宇宙船の航行速度は０になる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-218o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">操縦ドロイドが断末魔の叫びを上げた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' They Got R2!

'''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to attempt to destroy a starship's astromech droid or nav computer. Draw destiny. If it exceeds 1, deploy on the starship. That ship's hyperspeed becomes 0.

'''Lore:''' The astromech droid gave a dying scream.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[I've Lost Artoo!]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
